dedupe_keys.name: yield potential and yield gap atlas ypyga successor of the global yield gap atlas

description: An agronomic database of actual and potential crop yields and yield gaps. The YPYGA home page says the atlas covers the main staple food and vegetable oil crops in 83 countries on six continents with actual and potential yield and yield gap, actual and potential water productivity, and the underlying weather, soil and cropping system data, aggregated bottom-up by climate zones and technology extrapolation domains; YPYGA started in March 2026 to continue the Global Yield Gap Atlas developed from 2011 to 2025 by the University of Nebraska and Wageningen University. Data are free to download under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with citation guidance. Coverage is 83 countries. Caveats: the old coverage and download page returned a 404, so downloads are through the new atlas, and non-commercial terms apply. For simulation it gives water-limited yield potential by region, to estimate how drought or irrigation loss changes crop output. A related catalogue record is the GGCMI global gridded crop model outputs.
